title: Smoothness of a ring map is local on the target ring: a cover by principal opens with smooth localizations
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and let $g_1,\dots,g_m\in S$ ($m\ge0$) generate the unit ideal of $S$. For each $j$ let $S_{g_j}$ be the localization of $S$ at $\{1,g_j,g_j^2,\dots\}$, an $R$-algebra via $R\to S\to S_{g_j}$. If every $R\to S_{g_j}$ is a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], then $R\to S$ is smooth.
